claims.text: The initial AlCrFeNiSi is fabricated by LPBF at 200 W laser power and 1000 mm/s scan speed.
The as-built LPBF AlCrFeNiSi has approximately 5 vol % porosity.
The as-built LPBF AlCrFeNiSi has approximately 300 MPa residual tensile stress.
The as-built LPBF AlCrFeNiSi contains Si-rich microsegregation bands.
The proposed intervention is HIP at 1150 °C and 100 MPa for 3 hours in Ar within 48 hours after the build.
HIP will close internal pores in LPBF AlCrFeNiSi.
HIP will dissolve microsegregation zones in LPBF AlCrFeNiSi.
HIP will relax residual tensile stress in LPBF AlCrFeNiSi.
High-temperature, high-pressure diffusion and creep will drive pore shrinkage.
The specified HIP treatment will induce dynamic recrystallization.
Diffusion, creep, dynamic recrystallization, and stress relaxation will homogenize the alloy composition.
Pore closure and homogenization will eliminate crack-nucleation sites.
HIP will reduce porosity to below 0.5 vol %.
HIP will reduce residual tensile stress by at least 50% relative to as-built LPBF AlCrFeNiSi.
HIP will increase yield strength by 5–10% relative to as-built LPBF AlCrFeNiSi.
HIP will increase elongation by 15–25% relative to as-built LPBF AlCrFeNiSi.
The claimed effects apply within the stated LPBF, HIP, room-temperature, and quasi-static tensile-test boundaries.
The quantitative effects were extrapolated from HIP data for analogous additively manufactured HEAs and stainless steels.
Direct HIP data for AlCrFeNiSi are lacking.

contradictions.description: Starting from approximately 5 vol % porosity, the predicted endpoint of below 0.5 vol % requires more than a 90% reduction, but the falsification rule accepts any reduction of at least 50% when accompanied by the strength increase. Thus an outcome such as 1–2 vol % porosity could violate the stated prediction without falsifying the hypothesis under its own rule.

The hypothesis initially uses the ambiguous comparator 'conventionally as-built material,' while the outcome and baseline specifically use as-built LPBF AlCrFeNiSi. Conventional bulk fabrication and as-built LPBF are distinct comparators in the query.
